20 -> 13. Seven more services converted from a literal-returning start() to a class: tree_processor, title, slow_rpc, scss_error_display, color_scheme, density, lazy_session (session_service.js) and shareTarget.

lazy_session: `_fetchServerData` is underscored -- the literal published only `getValue`. The `webClientReadyPromise` resolver is still a local captured in the constructor, because the bus listener needs the raw resolve function and nothing else ever calls it.

shareTarget: THE DETECTION STAYS IN THE CONSTRUCTOR, not in start(). This is the opposite call to web_vitals / profiling / scss_error_display, and the distinction is the point: failing those guards means there is no service at all, so start() returns undefined; failing the share-target check does NOT -- `hasSharedFiles()` must still answer false for every caller. A guard belongs in start() only when the answer is "no service", not merely "nothing to do".
